# Syntecxhub Identity

> Enterprise Access Governance, Workforce Directory & IAM Security Telemetry platform.

## Overview
Syntecxhub Identity is an enterprise-grade Identity & Access Management (IAM) suite engineered with Nuxt 4 (SSR Nitro) and NestJS (Mongoose/MongoDB). It provides high-speed workforce directories, real-time role governance, and cryptographic zero-trust audit telemetry.

## Core Capabilities
- **Workforce Directory**: Search, filter, and audit team members across departments with real-time reactive filters.
- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**: Support for Admin, Manager, Editor, and Viewer roles with strict server-side validation.
- **Security Audit Logs**: Track security logins, permission elevation, and administrative changes in real time.
- **OpenAPI Architecture**: Standardized RESTful endpoints documented via Swagger / OpenAPI at `/api-docs`.

## Key URLs
- Homepage / Dashboard: https://identity.syntecxhub.com/
- User Directory: https://identity.syntecxhub.com/users
- System Configuration: https://identity.syntecxhub.com/settings
- OpenAPI Explorer: https://identity.syntecxhub.com/api-docs

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: Nuxt 4.6, Vue 3.5, Tailwind CSS, Pinia
- Backend: NestJS 11, MongoDB 8, TypeScript
- Authentication: Internal SSR key exchange, Zero-Trust headers
